label: Meat eaten per person per day
context: About 1.7 to 2.7 times the 50 to 80 g recommendation; 155.3 g in cities; up from 84 g in 2010.

label: Animal share of protein supply
context: Up from 21% in 1990 and 28% in 2000; neighbours plateau at 55% to 60% (Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Malaysia).

label: Price floor for everyday protein (eggs and chicken)
context: Eggs 34,300; chicken thigh 39,000; chicken breast 44,800 at Bach Hoa Xanh online. Tofu 30,000 on composition-table protein. Lean pork 70,900; beef 130,000 to 143,000; shrimp about 200,000.
source_ids: COST-39; COST-40; COST-41; DIE-12; DIE-23; DIE-15; DIE-16

label: Meat share of household food spending
unit: % of food, drink and eating-out spending
context: Largest single item; up from 21.3% in 2018 after the pork price spike. Fish 8.4%, eggs 1.3%, tofu 0.7%.

label: Eating out share of household food spending
unit: % of food, drink and eating-out spending
context: 29.6% in cities, 16.1% in rural areas; peak 26.7% in 2018 before COVID-19.

label: Projected rise in meat food use per person
unit: kg per person per year, retail weight
context: OECD-FAO baseline; poultry rises from 17.0 to 25.8 kg. Total four-meat food use rises by about 1.56 million tonnes (our multiplication).

label: Pork price shock and substitution
context: Pig producer price 46,076 to 78,138 VND per kg (2019 to 2020) while chicken price was flat; pork consumption fell 12.6% and chicken rose 26% in 2019.

label: Tofu eaten at home
context: Flat since 2012 (0.45); 0.69 kg in the Red River Delta vs 0.19 kg in the Mekong Delta; tofu is 0.7% of food spending.
